name: HOOK
thought: Eggo's tired of that thin cord, needs a thick trunk to really crack open this stage.

wants.item: A thicker beam for a double backflip
A higher perch to launch tail grabs
A thick branch for a real flip
That heavy steel beam to look scary
A high perch to launch tail grabs
A heavy steel beam to look scary
A thick trunk for a real backflip
An espresso shot to keep the buzz going
Thick oak branch for a real flip
More espresso to keep the focus tight

diary.line: Dangled near the old CRT TV, letting gravity do the work while they scroll by. The neon lights catch the fur just right; no one's looking close enough to see the precision in...
I launched a pogo hop off the floating stone, tail tip gripping the edge, while I swirled my espresso cup; the crowd barely noticed.
I swung onto the purple cabinet, tail draped over the side, and let the neon flicker as I stared down the pixel crowd, feeling the buzz of the game.
I used the tail to yank a floating crate into place, turning the banana grove into a slick launch pad for the next stunt.
I perched on the lookout, eyes on the tiny hut across the bridge, and slipped a clean backflip, tail looping around the rope as the onlookers barely blinked.
Locked the tail onto the string lights with surgical precision while the crowd scrolls by; the vibration is getting loud and my ego is already full.
Drooping over this wet pond with nothing but the breeze for a launchpad feels cheap. My tail is tired of vibrating on air and needs solid ground to really show what it's made of.
Snagged a banana with the tail tip and bit it dry; too short a lever to spin anything meaningful. The pixels are getting bored of my stillness.
Took another bite out of that stale banana; tail's still twitching from the neon cord and I need something solid to really crack open this low-poly stage.
Dangling on that thin twig feels like a bad joke; the crowd's bored of my limp pose. Need a solid branch to backflip properly before someone catches me mid-air.
Sipped that hot bean shot while watching the crowd scroll past on their stone steps. My tail's still pogo-ing from the last bounce, feels cheap hanging on air again.
The neon lights feel cheap when your tail is just grabbing on air. I need a solid tree trunk to launch into something the crowd can't ignore.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
